reviews.title: It was okay but if you are building a new pc save the little bit more money
reviews.comment: It does decent when playing games or doing schoolwork, but it doesn't deliver the graphic quality I want for Rainbow six siege or grand theft auto. Personally I wish I would've save another $100 and gotten a better gpu
reviews.author: Blake

reviews.title: Would have bought different
reviews.comment: Still very dusty inside and the fans squeak when they first start up. Would not buy again
reviews.author: Zachary Allen Schmidt

reviews.title: Condition not as promised by Amazon
reviews.comment: My card arrived scratched and dirty, with noticeable corrosion on the heat sinks. One fan connector was loose and had a bent pin that I had to fix before the fan could be connected. This was not anywhere the quality promised by Amazon, which is very disappointing.
reviews.author: Alan D

reviews.title: WORST DECISION EVER I MADE
reviews.comment: "looks like brand new"????!!! what the heck, it's so rusty and even the cable is broke, wtf.
reviews.author: Tzu Chun Huang

reviews.title: Incredibly Disappointed
reviews.comment: This thing looked like it was dipped in dirty water then left to sit in the sun. All the ports were full of rust, screws were rusty, cooling fins and tubes all corroded and growing corrosion to the circuit board. Absolutely amazed this was packed and shipped. Be sure to look over all components prior to installs. Disgusted to say the least
reviews.author: shane
